tool_schemas.name: save_project_context
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a project-scoped context snippet with the given id under projectId, storing content plus optional parentContextId, references, tags, and metadata, and returns the saved context record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty, if references/tags are not arrays of strings, or if parentContextId/references are provided but not valid IDs; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the project and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if write limits are reached. Raises NOT_FOUND if projectId does not exist or any specified parentContextId/references do not resolve within the same project scope, and CONFLICT if the id already exists under a different scope/type (e.g., conversation) or violates relationship rules (e.g., self-referential parent).

tool_schemas.name: save_conversation_context
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a conversation-session context snippet with the given id under sessionId, optionally linking it as a continuation of another context via continuationOf, and returns the saved context record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/empty, if tags are not an array of strings, or if continuationOf is not a valid ID; raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the session and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if write limits are reached. Raises NOT_FOUND if sessionId does not exist or continuationOf does not resolve within the same session, and CONFLICT if the id already exists under a different scope/type (e.g., project) or if continuationOf would create an invalid chain (e.g., pointing to itself).

tool_schemas.name: get_context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the context record for id, including its stored content, tags, metadata, and any recorded relationship fields; if projectId is provided, the lookup is constrained to that project’s contexts. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if id (or projectId when provided) is empty/invalid and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the owning project/session. Raises NOT_FOUND if no context with that id exists in the resolved scope (or within the specified projectId).

id.description: ID of the context to retrieve

projectId.description: Optional project ID for project contexts

tool_schemas.name: list_contexts
tool_schemas.description: Lists stored contexts, optionally filtered by projectId, tag, and/or type, and returns an array of matching context records; results are returned in a single page (no pagination parameters are supported). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if type is not one of "project" or "conversation" or if filter values are malformed, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you request contexts from a project/session you cannot access. Raises NOT_FOUND when filtering by projectId that does not exist, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if read limits are reached.

projectId.description: Optional project ID to filter by

tool_schemas.name: delete_context
tool_schemas.description: Transitions a context to status='deleted' and returns the updated context record. Refuses to delete an already-deleted context (NOT_FOUND) and refuses if you lack access to the owning project/session (UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed IDs.

id.description: ID of the context to delete

tool_schemas.name: save_project
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a project record and returns the saved project. If the project already exists, updates name/description/status (subject to lifecycle rules). Refuses invalid status transitions (VALIDATION_ERROR) and refuses if you lack permission (UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN).

status.description: Project lifecycle status; must follow allowed transitions

tool_schemas.name: get_project
tool_schemas.description: Returns the project record for id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if id is empty/invalid, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you do not have access, and NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist or is status='deleted'.

id.description: ID of the project to retrieve

tool_schemas.name: list_projects
tool_schemas.description: Lists projects visible to the caller, optionally filtered by status, and returns a paginated result set. Raises UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to list projects.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response

tool_schemas.name: save_conversation_session
tool_schemas.description: Creates or updates a conversation session record and returns the saved session. If the session already exists, updates title/status (subject to lifecycle rules). Refuses invalid status transitions (VALIDATION_ERROR) and refuses if you lack permission (UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN).

id.description: Unique identifier for the conversation session

status.description: Conversation session lifecycle status; must follow allowed transitions
